text:
alex: Quick bakeoff run — GPTQ vs AWQ vs FP8 on Llama-2-13B / Mistral-7B / Qwen-7B. Looking for regressions before we flip Dedicated defaults. TL;DR: GPTQ4 is fine for Llama, Mistral prefers AWQ4, Qwen shows KV drift. @maria @chen

maria: Which evals did you run? MMLU, lambada, code?

alex: MMLU (10-task subset), Lambada (zero-shot), PIQA, and WikiText-103 perplexity. Also did a small rerank quality check. Command used: ```bash
run_bakeoff --models llama-2-13b,mistral-7b,qwen-7b --quants gptq4,awq4,fp8 --eval mmlu,lambada,piqa,wikitext --seed 42
```

chen: Can you paste the core deltas (just the surface numbers)? small table is fine.

alex: RESULTS snapshot (relative to FP16 baseline):
Model | FP16 MMLU | GPTQ4 delta | AWQ4 delta | FP8 delta | Notes
Llama-2-13B | 73.6 | -0.8 | -1.2 | -0.5 | GPTQ stable, tiny perf win
Mistral-7B   | 70.4 | -1.9 | -0.6 | -1.2 | AWQ preserves accuracy better here
Qwen-7B      | 68.1 | -3.4 | -2.8 | -2.0 | GPTQ had KV drift on long ctx runs

WikiText perplexity (gptq4): Llama +4.5%, Mistral +6.8%, Qwen +10%
Lambada exact match deltas: Llama -0.7, Mistral -1.4, Qwen -3.1
PIQA change: all within ±1.2 points except Qwen(gptq) -2.7

Latency (single-token p99 on A100-80GB): FP16=18ms, GPTQ4=16ms, AWQ4=20ms, FP8=14ms. Throughput trends roughly inverse of p99.

sam: You mention KV drift on Qwen — got a quick log snippet?

alex: snippet: ```
[2026-02-12T14:02:10Z] INFO kv-cache: step=1024 topk_divergence=0.237 > threshold(0.2)
[2026-02-12T14:02:10Z] WARN decode: token_mismatch at pos=1228, top1_fp16=\"the\" top1_gptq=\"a\"
```

maria: Ouch. Does that point to accumulator / rounding? or KV index alignment?

alex: Suspect quant scale mismatch during KV write-back; Qwen's attention pattern + grouped-kv layout seems sensitive. Short-term mitigation: use 64-bit accumulators for KV update or force fp16 fallback for long contexts.

chen: Recommendation? rollout plan?

alex: Proposal:
- Roll GPTQ4 to Hosted/Dedicated for Llama-2-13B (canary 1% -> 10%)
- For Mistral-7B, prefer AWQ4 in Dedicated for now (better acc, slightly higher latency)
- Hold Qwen-7B GPTQ4 until we resweep with accumulator change + longer KV tests
- Add regression alert: MMLU delta > 1.5 triggers automatic rollback and eval snapshot

chen: I'll queue a resweep with seeds [42,7,99] and extended ctx (8k->32k) tomorrow. @sam can you attach perf profile?

sam: added trace id rwd-bake-173820, dashboard draft: https://console/redwood/dash/rwd-bake-173820. Also pinned perf flame and nvprof extract.

deploy-bot: New artifact uploaded: gptq4-bake-173820.tar.gz (size 2.1GB) :package:

maria: Please snapshot prompts + seeds to S3 so we can reproduce exactly.

alex: done — s3://rwd-bakeoffs/173820/{artifacts,configs,prompts}. Seeds and run.yml saved.

sam: I'll add a Console check that blocks Dedicated default flip until Qwen long-ctx KV divergence < 0.1 for 3 consecutive runs.

maria: 👍 thanks. can we tag owners and make an issue?

alex: created issue INF-1129 \"Qwen GPTQ4 KV drift resweep\" and assigned to @chen. Notes + logs attached.

chen: on it, starting the resweep in ~30m.

alex: thanks all. follow-ups: perf + quality sweep in one week, then re-eval rollout plan. :spiral_calendar:
